LayerConfig.enabled: boolean, default false; no live-run hyperparameters invented
LayerConfig.feature_dim: Recorded per-CAV x width; 29+48 for the existing five-second V2V intent configuration. Separate recorded context.v2v blocks are widened with the existing widen_context helper.

api.CooperationLayer(base, config=None, trig: Owns a deep-copied, eval-mode, requires_grad=False MAPPO base including actor, critic, intent, log_std and buffers. No config means OFF. Residual initialization preserves the caller's global CPU RNG for both enabled and disabled configurations.
api.trigger_head: Injected T2A nn.Module or adapter: forward(per_cav_features) -> finite [CAV, K] logits. Candidate index 0 is none. The test-only TriggerStub is not a production replacement for T2A. Caller construction of the supplied adapter precedes this wrapper's RNG-preservation boundary.
api.forward(context): Returns frozen base mean plus residual, and frozen base value. Discrete move sampling is exposed through sample, not forward.
api.sample(context, generator, deterministic: Returns (sample, unchanged-base-noise next_memory). Additional arguments are keyword-only. move_offsets is [CAV, K], with a zero none column, supplied from observable/feasible T1A candidates for the acting CAV. Stochastic triggers require a separate CPU layer_generator. Enabled samples retain rollout logits, residual, amplitude, choices, offsets and features under sample.coop_layer.
api.score(sample): Differentiable joint categorical plus correlated Gaussian score, and detached base value. Frozen AR(1) parameters and covariance are preserved.
api.layer_parameters(): Only residual-head, supplied trigger-head, and trigger-amplitude trainable parameters; no base parameters.
api.optimizer: Separate Adam created only when explicitly enabled; optimizer ownership checked before updates.
api.joint_kl(sample): Exact KL(old rollout || current), integrating all categorical choices and the shared-noise Gaussian analytically. The budget is mean joint KL per group across the supplied rollout records.
api.update(records, epochs=registered_intege: Layer-only clipped PPO. Each record is {sample, group_advantage}; the scalar advantage is supplied externally. Under the shared spec's 02:30 redesign, production integration must derive it from real observable-neighbourhood team reward, with WM counterfactual credit OFF. The layer performs no reward computation or critic update. Proposals exceeding the registered KL budget, or becoming nonfinite, restore layer weights and Adam state. Deterministic, empty, and executed-plan records are refused.
api.checkpoint: Save state_dict(), optimizer.state_dict(), LayerConfig and both caller-owned RNG states. Construct with the same trigger adapter/config and load both state dicts on resume; exact optimizer/model continuation is tested.

identity_contract.construction: Exact global CPU RNG preservation with no config, default enabled=False, explicit enabled=False, and enabled=True, with and without an injected trigger adapter.
identity_contract.layer_off: Complete base sample and score delegation, including action bytes, values and noise memory, even with nonzero learned layer weights. Construction plus sampling with torch.default_generator matches the unwrapped base from the same starting state.
identity_contract.zero_init: Residual output layer and tanh trigger amplitude start at zero. Deterministic and stochastic triggers preserve base action bytes, AR(1) noise memory and base generator state over multiple steps. Both separately seeded generators and the default CPU generator are covered.
identity_contract.frozen_after_updates: Actual accepted updates change residual/trigger parameters while the entire base state_dict, gradients, forward outputs and published intent remain unchanged.
identity_contract.safety_boundary: Produces pre-safety acceleration offsets only. Does not issue commands or alter existing feasibility bounds. Candidate eligibility and partner commitments remain with T1A/T2A and the runtime integration.
